audience: fundraisers and charity teams that run campaigns on Tiltify

useCases.title: Check which campaigns are live and how much each raised
useCases.text: Find your Tiltify user ID, then list your campaigns with the amount raised, goal and status. Filter to published or retired campaigns.

useCases.title: Review the latest donations to one campaign
useCases.text: List the donations to a campaign with the amount, time, public donor name and donor comment. Supporter contact details are not returned.

useCases.title: Find the top donors of a campaign for a period
useCases.text: List the top donors of a campaign for a time window, in leaderboard order, with name, amount and link.

useCases.title: Rank the top fundraisers of a campaign
useCases.text: List the users or teams that raise the most for a campaign in a time window. Each entry shows the name, amount and link.

useCases.title: Summarize the progress of one campaign
useCases.text: Read the donor and fundraiser leaderboards and the recent donations of one campaign. Ask the assistant for a short progress summary.
